description: This Java class handles commands for changing a user's password within the Fineract platform. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and utilizes the AppUserWritePlatformService to perform the password update.

classes.name: ChangeUserPasswordCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles change user password commands. It processes the command by invoking the write platform service to update the user's password.

methods.name: ChangeUserPasswordCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the AppUserWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the change password command by extracting the user ID and invoking the service to change the password.
